S001 proves both inductions with the stated bases and valid steps. In S002, iterating the x identity gives i! times the descending lambda product, nonzero for 0<=i<=lambda; division by i! preserves nonvanishing. The displayed polynomial in h isolates each coefficient, since its value at lambda-2j is the nonzero product of 2(k-j). Thus the dimension count yields the basis. In S003 the coefficient of e_i in (h+lambda+2)z is 2(lambda+1-i) times its coefficient in z, nonzero for i in I; hence z=0 and all higher powers vanish. Normalization gives all generator formulas. S004 correctly iterates them, including strings reaching zero, and divides by r!. The lambda=0 and r=0 cases use the stated empty-product conventions. There are no infinite sums or limits.
